recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, intimate portrait of a blonde female musician seated against a neutral corner, holding an acoustic guitar diagonally across the frame, paired with bold, high-contrast serif typography in the upper right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal line of the guitar neck leads the eye toward the subject's face.
The warm wood tones of the guitar harmonize with the subject's hair and skin tones.
The stark black typography provides a sharp graphic anchor against the soft, textured background.
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused indoor lighting with subtle shadows
Acoustic guitar as the primary prop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is seated, occupying the left and center-bottom of the frame at a medium-close scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The acoustic guitar body acts as the central weight, while the text anchors the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the face, follows the guitar neck down, and then moves up to the bold text in the corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The upper right corner provides clean negative space for the typographic element.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm neutrals (cream, beige, tan) in the background and skin tones.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for the typography and clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Golden-brown wood tones of the guitar.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value (brightness), creating a soft, airy atmosphere.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid neon or overly vibrant colors
Stick to earth tones and skin-adjacent hues

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick and thin strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: None; standard high-contrast serif glyphs used
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single bold typeface to maintain focus on the portrait.

candidateDirections.reason: Classic high-contrast serif with vertical stress.
Provides the necessary weight and sharp serifs.
Refined modern serif with elegant proportions.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A high-quality photograph of a blonde woman with wavy hair sitting in a corner on a knit blanket, holding a wooden acoustic guitar. Soft, warm indoor lighting. The top right corner should be a plain off-white wall.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist name in the top right corner using a bold Didone serif font in black, all caps, with tight tracking and a period at the end.

verificationChecks: Is the text in the top right corner?
Does the font have extreme thick-to-thin contrast?
Is the lighting soft and warm?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the artist
Any trademarked logos on the guitar headstock

mustAchieve: Balanced composition between subject and text

postGenerationChecks: Check for anatomical correctness of hands on the guitar.
Ensure the text does not overlap the subject's hair.
Verify the high-contrast nature of the serif font.
Confirm the warm, neutral color balance.
recipe.reuseFormula: Intimate musician portrait + high-contrast Didone typography + neutral warm palette.
